authority: Independent artboard before product implementation. Changes require an explicit recorded design decision; product screenshots cannot replace this source.

geometry.narrowBehavior: Wrap prose and controls; preserve 16px side gutters and minimum touch targets. Modals scroll inside viewport without hiding actions.

h5.purpose: Browser layout comparison with nx_device=off; product safe area must come from its actual environment.

typography.fontFamily: General Sans, Manrope, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
typography.cjkFallback: Installed Windows sans-serif fallback, recorded by browser environment. CJK glyphs are not included in General Sans.

glass.staticContent: Flat neutral content; no nested glass reward cards.
glass.baselineTechnique: Independent CSS optical target: backdrop blur, saturation, translucent tint, inner rim/highlight and pressed scale. Product implementation must use existing LiquidGlass renderer and be compared to this target; the design is not a claim of WebGL parity.
glass.reducedTransparency: Opaque surface and opaque brand action, backdrop-filter none
glass.reducedMotion: No animation, transition or pressed transform

entitlements.display: Every group carries explicit design-only disclosure. Values are isolated sample fields, never operational defaults.
entitlements.onMissing: Disable all purchase confirmation actions; retain readable failure and return controls.

assets.hashes: Recorded in report.json; original source image pixels copied without editing.

interactionContract.advert: Home to existing Store, no required marketing detail interstitial
interactionContract.skuCard: Card image to product details; buy CTA to existing checkout
interactionContract.leave: One prompt per unchanged fixture scope. Close/Escape/backdrop restore focus; second leave exits directly. Session marker, selection and original order survive navigation/reload. Draft return requires new quote; reserved return retains payBy.
interactionContract.cancel: Separate transaction consequence; illustrative control cannot write an order
interactionContract.unknownPayment: Unknown context remains tied to original order, selection and query-only actions. Explicit queryResult=unpaid fixture is required to demonstrate confirmed original-order retry.
interactionContract.rewardPages: Selected type/status/source propagate to details; only granted specimen has a receipt and enabled asset entry. Device entry differs from currency wallet entry.
interactionContract.quantityControls: Any change marks quote stale; removes prior line prices, totals and estimated rewards; disables confirmation, including after rules round-trip. No quote engine.
interactionContract.modal: Two discoverable 48px actions; Tab contained, Escape continues purchase
interactionContract.missingLeaveFacts: Empty/loading/error/disabled artboards do not show a marketing leave dialog; explicit leave returns to Store.
interactionContract.aftercare: Paid order and fully refunded order are separate samples. Individual rewards retain their own status; no row-level refund control.
interactionContract.rules: Remember source screen, selection, state and scroll; back restores the same position.

notFrozenFacts: Operational decisions D01-D11 and publication approval remain in PRODUCT-PRD; samples provide no defaults.
Reward maturity, device rights/activation, withdrawal eligibility, expiry and recovery policy need approved policy references; layout holds readable terms without asserting values.
Backend OpenAPI names, decimal representation, pagination and error codes are not defined by this visual artifact.
Live product prices, stock, purchase eligibility, activity dates and actual localized campaign copy remain server-owned.
Trial-conversion and trade-in applicability must be explicitly supported by the frozen contract; this artboard does not enable it.
Safe-area illustration is not a physical device measurement; native status bar, gesture areas and compositor behavior require real-device validation.
CJK fallback rasterization and GPU optical rendering can differ outside the recorded environment.
This is a design candidate; product runtime, asset persistence, production enablement and two independent pixel reviews are not passed by this check.

verification.entryMode: Playwright file URL only; no HTTP server or external requests
verification.fullMatrix: 19 screens x 7 states x 3 locales x 2 themes x 3 widths; plus 9 semantic variants x 3 locales x 2 themes x 3 widths; 4 additional H5 zero-inset comparisons at zh/dark/390
verification.screenshots: Viewport captures: all states at zh/dark/390 including main-scroll continuation; normal state at every locale/theme/width. Header and tabbar remain pinned.
checks: original unknown order cannot gain payment through navigation
single prompt per scope across return/reload

designDecisions.basis: Six independent review findings against APP01-09 and PRODUCT P5; no product runtime screenshot used.
changes: Reward selection retains type, status, source and receipt-dependent asset entry. NEX has a full store/order specimen.
Unknown order remains query-only across linked order and return paths. Only explicit queryResult=unpaid specimen can enable original-order retry.
Checkout scope and leavePromptShown survive close, navigation and reload. Reserved deadline remains payBy.
Named isolated design-only device/funds terms; missing terms prohibit confirmation.
Rules return to source selection, state and scroll position.
Quantity edits invalidate amounts and rewards, disable confirmation and persist stale quote across navigation.
Native illustration keeps explicit 24/26 sample insets; platform=h5 exports the same layout at zero system insets, without simulated home indicator. Native hardware not verified.
